 US President Donald Trump rules out immediate military action against Iran, saying there will not be a strike on Sunday.

 United States President Donald Trump has ruled out immediate military action against Iran, saying “there will not be a strike today”. Earlier, he suggested Washington might have to “finish the job” – or could reach a deal with Tehran.
 Iran’s parliament speaker says the US has entered a “quagmire” because of miscalculations in launching the war and Washington must now “take the necessary steps to extricate” itself.
